args.prompt: A sprite kit for a cute 2D pixel art game background: exactly 8 separate objects arranged in a clean grid of 4 columns by 2 rows, each object fully visible, well separated with plenty of empty space around it, none touching or overlapping. Soft pastel 16-bit pixel art with hard square chunky pixels, simple flat shading with one highlight tone and one shadow tone, light from the top left, NO dark outlines (soft background art), no anti-aliasing, no text, no labels. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else. Same warm pastel palette family as the reference drawing (lavender, pink and yellow). Theme: COTTON CANDY CLOUDS. The 8 objects are: (1) a very big fluffy pink cloud, (2) a big fluffy pink cloud with a different shape, (3) a medium pink cloud, (4) a medium pink-lilac cloud, (5) a small pink cloudlet, (6) a tiny pink cloudlet, (7) a medium pink cloud with a sleepy happy smiling face, (8) a long thin wispy pink cloud streak. Colors: soft pinks (#FFE6F3, #FFC2E0, #F79CCB) with slightly deeper pink shadows.
